videos.title: The Christmas Club
videos.description: Two busy strangers meet when they help an elderly woman find her lost Christmas savings. Thanks to fate and Christmas magic, they also find something they were both missing: true love.

videos.title: The Christmas Charade
videos.description: Facing another dull Christmas alone, sparks fly when a risk-averse librarian accidentally gets wrapped up with a grinchy FBI agent in an undercover mission to save the Heart of Christmas.

videos.title: A Magical Christmas Village
videos.description: A woman tells her young granddaughter, Chloe, that her miniature Christmas village can magically grant holiday wishes. As Chloe begins setting up the figurines, real-life events seem to mimic the scenes she creates.

videos.title: One December Night
videos.description: Two music managers must put their history aside to oversee the televised reunion performance of their rock star fathers with a fractured past.

videos.title: A Season for Miracles
videos.description: A woman (Carla Gugino) tries to save her sister's (Laura Dern) children from foster care by taking them to a small town where she is mistaken for a missing heiress.

videos.title: A Gift to Remember
videos.description: A hopeless romantic, Darcy, insists on being swept off her feet. One day, while bicycling to work, Darcy crashes into a sharply dressed man walking his dog. He falls into a coma; she takes the dog home, waiting to reunite him with his owner.

videos.title: Cherished Memories: A Gift to Remember 2
videos.description: As Darcy and Aiden prepare to celebrate their second Christmas together, an unexpected guest and a fight to save the beloved community center unites everyone for an unforgettable holiday.

videos.title: Mistletoe Murders: Don't Fear the Wreather
videos.description: Emily and Sam investigate a wreathmaker who's accused of killing her husbands, while Violet and June nominate Emily for town Cheerman in hopes of convincing her to stay in Fletcher's Grove.

videos.title: Northern Lights of Christmas
videos.description: Life deals Zoey Hathaway a strange blow when she inherits a reindeer farm and becomes buried in taking care of the animals and all the Christmas responsibilities.

videos.title: The Royal Nanny
videos.description: Working undercover as a nanny, an MI5 agent must resist the charms of Prince Colin while keeping the royal family safe during Christmastime.

videos.title: Christmas in Evergreen: Tidings of Joy
videos.description: A skeptical writer shows up in Evergreen to get the scoop on the town's famed passion for Christmas during a search for a long-lost time capsule.

videos.title: Trading Up Christmas
videos.description: Michelle tries to get her sister a new place to live and all she has is a Christmas stocking to trade with.

videos.title: My Norwegian Holiday
videos.description: A grieving woman forges a deep connection with a Norwegian man when he discovers she has a troll figurine from his hometown. She soon agrees to accompany him to Norway to uncover the troll's origins and find her own path to healing, love and family.

videos.title: Just in Time for Christmas
videos.description: A young psychology professor has to choose between marrying her longtime beau or accepting a once-in-a-lifetime job. To help her make a decision, a magical messenger lets her see both possible futures so she'll be able to make the right decision.

videos.title: Naughty or Nice
videos.description: Krissy Kringle (Hilarie Burton) receives Santa's naughty or nice book by accident and starts exposing the naughty deeds of people around her.

videos.title: Journey Back to Christmas
videos.description: A nurse from World War II is transported in time to 2016 and meets a man who helps her discover the bonds of family and that the true meaning of Christmas is timeless.

videos.title: Christmas Waltz
videos.description: A woman makes an unexpected connection with her dance instructor after her storybook Christmas wedding is canceled.

videos.title: A December Bride
videos.description: Layla accompanies Seth to her cousin's wedding, and everyone is surprised when she announces they're engaged. They are forced to keep up the pretense, and as they spend more time together, they find themselves feeling something very real.

videos.title: A Blue Ridge Mountain Christmas
videos.description: Hotel manager Willow returns to her stunning Virginia hometown to help her sister plan a Christmas wedding at the inn her family once owned.

videos.title: A Very Merry Bridesmaid
videos.description: Leah's 30th birthday is on Christmas Eve, the same day as her brother's wedding. Her childhood crush is back in town for the ceremony, and he's determined to make sure her special day doesn't go by the wayside.

videos.title: A Shoe Addict's Christmas
videos.description: Department store employee Noelle visits Christmases of past, present and future as her guardian angel helps her navigate her wishes for a connection with her father, her dream career and love.

videos.title: Christmas in Toyland
videos.description: A toy store data analyst tries to save hundreds of jobs right before Christmas to help keep the in-store experience alive.

videos.title: Christmas Festival of Ice
videos.description: Emma is determined to keep her hometown's Christmas ice-sculpting contest going. She enlists sponsors and artists, but Nick, the town's ace artisan, isn't interested in competing until he sees what Emma has accomplished.

videos.title: A Godwink Christmas: Second Chance, First Love
videos.description: After 15 years, a single father moves home from Hawaii with his two sons and, through a series of coincidences -- or Godwinks, ends up stuck in traffic next to his high school sweetheart.

videos.title: A Royal Christmas Crush
videos.description: Ava accepts the opportunity of a lifetime to work at the Royal Ice Hotel, which leads to a surprise whirlwind romance with the most important guest of all, the prince himself.

videos.title: Northpole
videos.description: When the power supply to Santa's city is threatened by a lack of holiday spirit, a youngster tries to help his busy mother rediscover the joys of the holiday season.

videos.title: I'm Not Ready for Christmas
videos.description: Holly's world is turned upside down when her niece's wish to Santa Claus comes true, and she cannot tell a lie. As her career and love life go into disarray, she must learn to judge between the truth and what is right.

videos.title: Hitched for the Holidays
videos.description: A man (Joey Lawrence) and a woman (Emily Hampshire) pose as a couple to fool their respective families.

videos.title: Under the Christmas Sky
videos.description: Sparks fly between astronaut Kat and by-the-book David when they work on a planetarium exhibit that's opening right before Christmas.

videos.title: A Kismet Christmas
videos.description: A children's author reconnects with her hometown, family and teenage crush while confronting a legend that may actually be true.

videos.title: Northpole: Open for Christmas
videos.description: During Christmastime a handyman and an elf persuade a businesswoman to keep the inn that she inherited from her aunt.

videos.title: It's Christmas, Eve
videos.description: A school superintendent with a knack for turning around schools meets a single father who works as the head of the school's bankrupt music department. As she rediscovers her passion for music, she works to save the dreams of the kids who love music.

videos.title: Christmas in Rome
videos.description: Angela, an American tour guide in Rome, agrees to teach a culture-shocked businessman named Oliver about the heart of Rome at Christmas.

videos.title: What If Christmas
videos.description: Erin wishes for a life as a fashion designer. It comes true, but at a cost: she never married her husband, Adam, and lives a lonely life at the top.

videos.title: Christmas for Keeps
videos.description: During Christmastime, some childhood friends return home after 10 years to take part in a celebration of life for their beloved high school teacher.

videos.title: Love Under the Mistletoe
videos.description: Grace and her former high school crush, Ryan, seem to constantly find themselves under the mistletoe as they work together to revive a beloved charity fundraiser.
